name: kvarto-crm
description: KvartoCRM — облачный офис для специалистов по недвижимости
author: KvartoCRM

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/prepare-spa-fallback.mjs && node scripts/verify-production-network.mjs
scripts.build:android: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:desktop:web && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.test: node --test src/lib/dealPropertySelection.test.ts src/lib/authGuards.test.ts src/lib/authCallback.test.ts src/lib/offlineTransport.test.ts src/lib/offlineTransport.integration.test.ts src/lib/dealFinance.test.ts src/lib/dealParticipants.test.ts src/lib/dealMapping.test.ts src/lib/planProgress.test.ts src/lib/monthlyPlanMapping.test.ts src/lib/recordCollectionMapping.test.ts src/lib/workspaceBackup.test.ts src/lib/navigation.test.ts src/lib/contacts.test.ts src/lib/contactExtrasMapping.test.ts src/lib/propertyHistoryMapping.test.ts src/lib/propertyPromotionMapping.test.ts src/lib/propertyMatching.test.ts src/lib/propertyMapping.test.ts src/lib/propertyOwners.test.ts src/lib/propertyRecordMapping.test.ts src/lib/propertyShowingMapping.test.ts src/lib/galleryMapping.test.ts src/lib/workspaceSearch.test.ts src/lib/taskMapping.test.ts src/lib/eventMapping.test.ts src/lib/callActivityMapping.test.ts src/lib/syncDiagnostics.test.ts src/lib/safeExternalUrl.test.ts src/lib/files.test.ts src/lib/pagination.test.ts
scripts.test:security: npm run test:security-db && npm run test:gateway && npm run test:service-worker && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
